title: Substitute
text: With $$x=u^6$$, you get $$dx=6u^5 du$$, $$\sqrt{x}=u^3$$ and $$\sqrt[3]{x}=u^2$$. The integral becomes the integral of $$\frac{6u^3}{u+1}$$.

title: Divide and integrate
text: Long division gives $$\frac{6u^3}{u+1}=6u^2-6u+6-\frac{6}{u+1}$$. This integrates to $$2u^3-3u^2+6u-6\ln\left(1+u\right)$$. Then put $$u=x^{\frac{1}{6}}$$.
